title: GOFAMINT Sunday School v1.1.5
releaseNotes:
• In-app update system with direct APK download
• Continuous (Vertical) and Page-by-page (Horizontal) Manual reading modes
• Anchored section navigation
• Smart Card generation from highlighted text
• Bible reading history & search history with one-tap reopen
• Multi-reference and abbreviation support (MK, JN, MT, etc.)
• High-resolution PNG direct device download
• Enhanced devotional voice reading with biblical pronunciation
